run_efm3d_eval_ase: run the EFM3D evaluation benchmark on the ASE dataset using --ase flag
run_efm3d_eval_adt: run the EFM3D evaluation benchmark on the ADT dataset using --adt flag
run_efm3d_eval_aeo: run the EFM3D evaluation benchmark on the AEO dataset using --aeo flag
run_efm3d_eval_custom_ckpt: run the EFM3D evaluation benchmark with a custom model checkpoint via --model_ckpt
run_efm3d_eval_subset: run the EFM3D evaluation benchmark on a subset of sequences using --num_seqs
